sections.Profile:
"Alice in Wonderland" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in August 1948. Designed by Harry Mabs, the game features six flippers, ten passive bumpers, and two kick-out holes. The artwork, created by Roy Parker, vividly captures the whimsical essence of Lewis Carroll's classic tale.
